result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java` with 26 JUnit 4 tests covering `FastDatePrinter`: formatting via `Date`/`Calendar`/`long`/`Object`, buffer reuse, unsupported-type and null errors, getters, `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`, 12/24-hour midnight boundaries, year padding/truncation edge cases, month/weekday/era/am-pm text fields, numeric fields (day-of-year, week-of-year, etc.), literal-quote escaping including an unterminated quote, illegal pattern character errors, and numeric/named timezone patterns. All tests compile under `-source 1.6` and pass via `./_tools/test.sh`.
